label: PF Backlog 469
title: AI consolidation of near-duplicate items at grooming (human-approved): fold unique parts + close the other as duplicate
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-07), after BI-PF-0432 (advisory marking).

Goal: when grooming finds a near-duplicate pair WITH unique parts, an AI-drafted CONSOLIDATION merges both into
one item, HUMAN-APPROVED, and closes the other as a duplicate (preserved). Today 0432 only marks
(`possible_duplicate_of`); this adds the merge.

Flow (reuses the existing grooming AI path):
1. PROPOSE (grooming, AI mode): for the groomed item X and a same-project near-duplicate candidate C, the AI
   drafts a CONSOLIDATED spec (title/body/acceptance_criteria/moscow) folding in C's unique points (citing both
   ids). Stored as a proposal - e.g. X.analysis.consolidation_proposal + X.links.possible_duplicate_of=[C].
   NOTHING is mutated yet.
2. APPROVE (human; grooming.decide or a review action): apply the consolidated spec to the canonical item
   (append the unique content - never drop), then
     - close the OTHER item: status = `duplicate` (terminal) with links.duplicate_of = [canonical ref] + a note;
       the closed item is KEPT (closed.json + history) as the audit trail - never deleted;
     - record the merge in decisions[] (source ids + reason).
   REJECT -> leave both as-is.
3. AI off / offline (PF_GROOMING_AI / PF_OFFLINE / CI) -> fall back to 0432 advisory marking only (no merge).

Guards: same (scope, project) only; human approval before ANY consolidation; source preserved; append unique bits;
deterministic fallback. No auto-merge without approval.

Out of scope: cross-project consolidation; auto-apply without approval; deleting the source item.

Related: BI-PF-0432 (marking), BI-0091 (ideas consolidation precedent).
dashboard_impact: operator surface = /pf backlog groom/decide + the API; no dashboard item.

## Requirement added: full traceability (user, 2026-10-07)
The consolidation must leave enough context that the duplicate/unique items are traceable:
- Canonical item records `links.consolidated_from = [<merged refs>]`; its `body` gains the APPENDED unique
  content (nothing dropped); an append-only `decisions[]` entry {at, by, decision: CONSOLIDATE, sources:[ids],
  folded:[unique points], reason}.
- Each closed item: status `duplicate`, `links.duplicate_of = [canonical]`, note "consolidated into <canonical>
  by <actor>"; kept in closed.json + history (never deleted).
=> traceable BOTH directions (canonical -> its sources + folded bits; each duplicate -> its canonical), with
   actor/time/reason in the ledger.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS; 2 tests. Human-approved consolidation: groom stores analysis.consolidation_proposal (AI-refinable; deterministic draft) when same-project near-dups exist; decide(CONSOLIDATE) folds unique content into the canonical (body/acceptance/moscow), records links.consolidated_from + a decisions[] entry, closes each duplicate (status duplicate + links.duplicate_of + note; preserved). Same-project only; AI off -> 0432 marking only.

decisions.decision: Consolidation must record provenance: canonical links.consolidated_from + appended unique content + decisions[] entry; closed item links.duplicate_of + note; both directions traceable
